ticket: Mark tasks as overdue and remind assignees every day until they are done.
notes: Reminders are one-shot (reminder_sent) and status has no overdue value. Daily cadence, quiet handling, stop conditions and status modelling are open.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Is overdue a stored status or derived from due date?
What 'every day' means (time of day, timezone, weekends).
When reminders stop (done, archived, reassigned, cap).
reminder_sent is a one-shot boolean; daily reminders need per-day state.
